definitions.explanation: The permanent end of menstruation, generally occurring naturally in women between their late 40s and early 50s. Also used as a suru-verb ({閉経|へいけい}する) meaning 'to reach menopause'.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}はもう{閉経|へいけい}した。
examples.english: My mother has already gone through menopause.

examples.japanese: {閉経|へいけい}は{女性|じょせい}にとって{大|おお}きな{変化|へんか}だ。
examples.english: Menopause is a major change for women.

examples.japanese: {閉経|へいけい}{後|ご}は{骨|ほね}が{弱|よわ}くなりやすい。
examples.english: After menopause, bones tend to become weaker.

examples.japanese: {日本人|にほんじん}{女性|じょせい}の{平均|へいきん}{閉経|へいけい}{年齢|ねんれい}は{約|やく}{五十|ごじゅう}{歳|さい}だと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: The average age of menopause in Japanese women is said to be around fifty.

notes:
Composed of {閉|へい} (close) and {経|けい} (here a shortening of {月経|げっけい}, menstruation). Medical term used in everyday speech as well; no coarser or more polite word is normally substituted.

USAGE:
- As a noun: {閉経|へいけい}を{迎|むか}える (to reach menopause).
- As a suru-verb: {閉経|へいけい}する (to undergo menopause), usually in the past tense: {閉経|へいけい}した.
- {閉経|へいけい}{後|ご} (post-menopausal) and {閉経|へいけい}{前|ぜん} (pre-menopausal) are common adjectival prefixes in medical and health contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {閉経|へいけい}を{迎|むか}える: to reach menopause
- {閉経|へいけい}{前後|ぜんご}: around the time of menopause
- {閉経|へいけい}{年齢|ねんれい}: age of menopause
- {早期|そうき}{閉経|へいけい}: early / premature menopause

RELATED TERMS:
- {月経|げっけい}: menstruation — the monthly process that ends at menopause
- {生理|せいり}: period (colloquial) — casual term for menstruation
- {更年期|こうねんき}: menopausal period / climacteric — the years of transition surrounding menopause
